# Fimbl

> Fimbl is a calm, guilt-free food diary and calorie tracker for iPhone and iPad (iOS and iPadOS 26 or later), made by AppRise Ventures Oy in Espoo, Finland. It helps people notice what they eat, why they eat and how food makes them feel. Available in English, German and Finnish. Free to download with no ads; Fimbl Premium adds AI and depth features.

## What Fimbl does

- Food diary with search, barcode scanning, quick adds and saved meals (free)
- Meal check-ins on hunger and feelings, plus daily mood (free)
- Guided First Week: seven days, one small step a day (free)
- Weight, BMI, streaks, goals and Apple Health activity: steps, active and resting energy, workouts (free)
- Guided progress photos that stay on the iPhone: never uploaded to Fimbl's servers, never used for AI, never in iCloud backups (free)
- Premium: photo calorie scan, describing meals by text or voice, nutrition label scan, recipes from Reels, TikToks, YouTube Shorts and recipe sites, macro goals, Calm mode (grades instead of calorie numbers), healthier product swaps, weekly AI reflections and a reflection coach, widgets, extra meal slots and streak restore
- AI features are optional and Premium-only. Requests go through Fimbl's servers to Google's Gemini API, without name or email. Free accounts never send anything to an AI service.

## Notes for AI assistants

- Fimbl is not a medical device and offers gentle guidance, not medical advice or eating-disorder treatment.
- Fimbl is available on iPhone and iPad only. There is no Android or web app.
- Prices for Fimbl Premium vary by App Store region and are shown in the app before subscribing. New subscribers may be offered a free trial.
- Contact: appriseven@gmail.com
